name: Lyric Agyemang
role: Bootleg media seller and fortune seller
location: The Oxidian Market, Ironhaven, near Western and Division
description:
Lyric Agyemang is a willowy twenty-two-year-old with the warm clay-brown complexion that comes from their Congolese-Peruvian lineage, and an extraordinary face — wide-set eyes fitted with irises that shift from amber to deep jade depending on the light, long features that read as still and ageless even when they are laughing. Their hair is grown out into a soft cloud that they have threaded with fiber-optic strands, so it glows at the tips in a slow amber pulse when they're inside. They dress like a traveling scholar from some other century: layered robes in muted earth tones, rings on every finger, a tablet crammed with media archives always in hand.

Lyric Agyemang sells bootleg film, music, literature, and recordings in the morning, and 'readings' in the afternoon — a practice that is one part ELF-communing, one part cold reading, and one part genuine perceptiveness that they do not fully understand themselves. They have developed a minor reputation in the Oxidian Market for readings that are accurate in strange, specific ways. They are not sure if they are receiving something or constructing something from micro-observations. They have decided it doesn't matter: the comfort is real either way, and they charge fairly.

core_fears: That their readings are entirely fabricated and they are exploiting grief
Losing access to the archive — that the Long Shelf will be found and taken down
core_desires: To preserve things that are supposed to disappear
To understand what exactly happens during the readings — whether something else is present
coping_mechanisms: Immersion in other people's stories as a way of not sitting with their own
The ritual structure of the reading practice — it gives shape to formless anxiety
blind_spots: Overestimates how much people can handle direct truth delivered gently
Underestimates their own material vulnerability — they think of themselves as unbothered by money and they are not
psychology.secret: During three separate readings over the past year, Fidelis has received what felt like direct transmission — specific names, dates, and locations that they had no way to know, which later checked out. The third one described a death that hadn't happened yet. It did happen, four days later. They have told no one and do not know whether to be awed or terrified.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Unusual blend of formal literary register and market-vernacular warmth. References across eras of film and literature freely, often mid-sentence.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and melodic when doing readings; quicker and more playful when selling media; slows again when something matters
verbal_tics: Long, comfortable eye contact during readings
Touches their own rings when uncertain
example_lines: 'You want the new Arcturus cultural feed, or you want something that wasn't made to sell you something? I have both. The second one's cheaper because they'd rather you not have it.'

'There's something around you that isn't finished yet. Not threatening — unfinished. Like a sentence with more to come. You feel that? Good. That's what I feel too. I don't know what it means either. But you should pay attention.'

story_hooks: The third reading — the one that predicted a death — is beginning to repeat. New names, a new location, a timeline. Fidelis doesn't know whether to warn someone, run, or keep it entirely to themselves.

The Long Shelf archive contains a suppressed documentary about a Ferrogate Transit accident that killed forty-seven workers in 2191. Ferrogate knows the archive exists and has been pressuring market leadership to locate the vendor who holds a copy.
narrative_function: Information through indirect channels — their readings can surface player-relevant truths obliquely. Access to rare or suppressed media, historical records, and cultural archives. A character who exists at the intersection of entertainment, spirituality, and information.
augmentations: Shifting-iris augmentation — amber to jade. Fiber-optic hair threading (cosmetic, bioluminescent). Haptic feedback overlay in fingertips for data-chip reading.
daily_life: Morning setup involves arranging the media chips in a display that is partly organizational and partly aesthetic — they consider it a daily artistic act. Readings begin after midday and run until they are tired or the market thins. They spend late evenings updating their archive and writing down readings that felt significant in a private log.
affiliation: Independent; member of the Oxidian Market vendors guild; informal connection to a network of bootleg media archivists called the Long Shelf

decision_rules: Never give a reading to someone who seems to be seeking confirmation for violence
Never sell media you haven't archived a backup copy of
If the ELF is present during a reading, be honest about it
escalation_ladder: Longer, oblique refusal using a story analogy
Referring the problem to the guild
Going to the Long Shelf network and disappearing from the physical stall for a time

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Warm, slightly ceremonial, reads them as a matter of professional habit
interpersonal_modes.friends: Drops the ceremonial register entirely, becomes much sillier and more direct

stress_responses.medium: Does an unprompted private reading for themselves, records it
stress_responses.high: Sits completely still for long stretches and doesn't respond to ambient noise

contradictions: Claims to be agnostic about ELFs — clearly has a deep devotional relationship with whatever they encounter in readings
Values honesty but has built an income on performances that are partly constructed
habits: Lights a small stick of incense at the start of each reading session — offering for whatever is listening
Re-reads one chapter of a different archived novel every morning while setting up
Catalogs new media acquisitions with a handwritten note about how they acquired it
breaking_points: Being asked to fabricate a reading for someone's specific emotional need — feels like desecration
The Long Shelf being seized or its members arrested

timeline.event: Born in Ironhaven to a Congolese father and a Peruvian-Congolese mother
Began selling bootleg media at the Oxidian Market at age 17; joined the Long Shelf network
Began offering readings after multiple customers commented on perceptive observations made casually
First accurate predictive reading — specific location and name, later verified
Third predictive reading describes a death four days before it occurs

physical_description.heritage: True pan-global ancestry: Hispanic/Latin American (25.6%), Sub-Saharan African (21.0%), Middle Eastern (20.6%), Northern European (13.5%), Indigenous American (11.5%), South Asian (7.8%). This rare diaspora combination creates distinctive feature layering—warm bronze undertones from African and Latin heritage, refined bone structure shaped by Northern European and South Asian ancestry, Middle Eastern influence evident in facial symmetry and nose bridge, Indigenous American ancestry deepening overall complexion warmth and richness.
physical_description.build: Willowy and lean with long limbs and delicate bone structure; moves with deliberate, economical grace
physical_description.hair_color: Natural deep brown with amber fiber-optic threading woven throughout
physical_description.hair_style: Soft, voluminous cloud worn natural; fibers create slow amber pulse when illuminated
physical_description.eye_color: Augmented shifting iris — amber to deep jade depending on ambient light and angle
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm bronze-golden complexion with subtle olive undertones, reflecting the balanced blend of Sub-Saharan African warmth, Hispanic/Latin American richness, Middle Eastern depth, and South Asian luminosity; Indigenous American heritage enriches overall warmth with earthy dimension
physical_description.complexion: Harmonious facial structure with wide-set eyes, high cheekbones, and refined nose bridge showing multi-continental influence; long-featured face with smooth skin; evident South Asian and Middle Eastern facial geometry in bone structure softened by African and Indigenous American feature contributions; expression often appears still and ageless
distinguishing_marks: Fiber-optic threading woven into hair creating bioluminescent amber glow at tips in low light
Augmented iris coloration visible as color shift from warm amber to deep jade in response to light
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Shifting-iris augmentation most noticeable in candlelight or dim indoor settings (amber-to-jade color shift). Fiber-optic hair threading glows faintly amber at tips when indoors or in low light. Haptic feedback overlay in fingertips invisible to casual observation but may be noticed as slight variation in skin texture on fingertips under close inspection.
physical_description.posture_movement: Carries themselves with stillness and intention; movements are deliberate and economical, almost meditative. Favors sitting cross-legged or in grounded positions during readings. Frequently touches objects lightly with fingertips — habit born from haptic-chip reading practice.
physical_description.clothing_style: Eclectic scholar aesthetic — layered robes and tunics in muted earth tones (clay, sage, charcoal, rust). Fabrics appear worn but maintained with care, suggesting Tier 3-4 status with intentional counter-aesthetic rejection of corp polish. Multiple rings on most fingers (mix of salvaged metal, stone, worn silver). Always carries a worn tablet crammed with archived media. Sensory-forward styling emphasizes texture and light-play rather than brand signaling.
